completion_boundary.interpretation: Primary comparisons preserve the frozen Q+Pair target. Solo-Q contrasts against Single/Pair are descriptive secondary analyses prepared during the run without inspecting partial outcomes; no retrospective performance gate is added. Model/seed lineage is not matrix reconstruction. Positive branch-protection deltas do not establish cost-free protection or per-instance dominance. A paired win ending on its primary branch is not automatically a direct Pair rescue; timing and changed later trajectories can also affect its output.
